notes: Conspicuous Snoop: 'Play with the top card of your library revealed. You may cast Goblin spells from the top of your library.' The reveal is a lifetime 'disclosure' layer (a zone-knowledge rule, a recorded no-op). Twelve turns burn the fillers until Goblin Arsonist sits on top; with {R} added at the step that spends it (pools empty as each step and phase ends, CR 500.5) the menu offers it as a cast from the library (CR 601.3) and it enters. Since ontology round R13 the permission is Snoop's static PERMIT, not a free activation.
